import bpy, bmesh, math
from mathutils import Matrix, Vector

def mat(name, col):
    m = bpy.data.materials.get(name) or bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.use_nodes = True
    b = next(n for n in m.node_tree.nodes if n.type == "BSDF_PRINCIPLED")
    b.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = col
    b.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = 0.7
    m.diffuse_color = col
    return m

wood = mat("Wood", (0.45, 0.26, 0.12, 1))
wood_dark = mat("Wood Dark", (0.30, 0.16, 0.07, 1))

def make(name, boxes, loc, rot_z, m):
    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    bm = bmesh.new()
    for (c, s) in boxes:
        mtx = Matrix.Translation(Vector(c)) @ Matrix.Diagonal((s[0], s[1], s[2], 1))
        bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0, matrix=mtx)
    bm.to_mesh(me); bm.free()
    old = bpy.data.objects.get(name)
    if old: bpy.data.objects.remove(old, do_unlink=True)
    ob = bpy.data.objects.new(name, me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(ob)
    ob.location = loc
    ob.rotation_euler = (0, 0, rot_z)
    me.materials.append(m)
    return ob

# Table: 1.6 x 1.0 top, 0.75 high
th = 0.75
boxes = [((0, 0, th - 0.03), (1.6, 1.0, 0.06))]
for x in (-0.72, 0.72):
    for y in (-0.42, 0.42):
        boxes.append(((x, y, (th - 0.06) / 2), (0.08, 0.08, th - 0.06)))
# aprons
boxes += [((0, 0.42, th - 0.11), (1.36, 0.03, 0.1)), ((0, -0.42, th - 0.11), (1.36, 0.03, 0.1)),
          ((0.72, 0, th - 0.11), (0.03, 0.76, 0.1)), ((-0.72, 0, th - 0.11), (0.03, 0.76, 0.1))]
make("Table", boxes, (0, 0, 0), 0, wood)

# Chair, local: front faces -Y... backrest at +Y, seat 0.45 high
sh = 0.45
cb = [((0, 0, sh - 0.025), (0.44, 0.44, 0.05))]
for x in (-0.19, 0.19):
    for y in (-0.19, 0.19):
        cb.append(((x, y, (sh - 0.05) / 2), (0.05, 0.05, sh - 0.05)))
# back posts and slats
for x in (-0.19, 0.19):
    cb.append(((x, 0.19, sh + 0.25), (0.05, 0.05, 0.5)))
cb.append(((0, 0.19, sh + 0.45), (0.38, 0.04, 0.1)))
cb.append(((0, 0.19, sh + 0.25), (0.38, 0.03, 0.06)))
# stretchers
cb.append(((0, -0.19, 0.12), (0.34, 0.03, 0.03)))
cb.append(((0, 0.19, 0.12), (0.34, 0.03, 0.03)))

# chairs: back faces away from table (back at +local Y pointing outward)
placements = [((0, -0.85, 0), 0 + math.pi),   # front side: back toward -Y
              ((0, 0.85, 0), 0),
              ((-1.15, 0, 0), math.pi/2),
              ((1.15, 0, 0), -math.pi/2)]
for i, (loc, rz) in enumerate(placements, 1):
    make(f"Chair {i}", cb, loc, rz, wood_dark)
print("ok")
